How we got here

Our Story

2009

How we met

We were seatmates in grade school. The feeling was mutual even then — we were simply far too young to do anything about it.

2022 · Tagaytay

Making it official

Thirteen years later, Nelson finally said it out loud. Chanel already knew: he was the one.

2025 · Hoi An, Vietnam

The proposal

In the middle of Ancient Town, under the scorching sun and the crowds of a busy street, Nelson got down on one knee and asked Chanel to be his wife.

6 December 2026

We say I do

And we would love for you to be there.

On the subject of

Gifts

With all that we have, we have been truly blessed. Your prayers and presence are all that we request. But if you wish to give nonetheless, a monetary gift for our future is one we suggest.

Good to know

Questions

Yes — parking is available on the premises at both the church and the reception venue. No need to arrange anything in advance.

As much as we adore your little ones, we have planned an adults-only celebration. We hope this gives you an evening to relax and enjoy yourselves with us.

We have reserved seats for the names printed on your invitation, and it will tell you how many seats we have set aside for you.

Please aim to be seated by 1:30 PM. The ceremony begins at 2:00 PM, and the doors close as the processional starts.

We would love you to be fully present with us for the mass itself, so we kindly ask that phones stay away during the ceremony. Afterwards, please take as many as you like.

Yes — please tag your photos #ChanelsonForevs so we can see the day through your eyes.

We hope you can make it
